topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I grip the edges of the box, my hands trembling. This isn't mine. The name scrawled across the label, unfamiliar, a ghost of the room before it was mine. My heart pounds, a relentless drumbeat against my ribs. I don't need more, I can barely handle what I already have. The weight of the box is crushing, a reminder of the life I don't lead, the person I'm not. I can't keep this, can't even touch it. The door creaks, a sliver of light slicing through the shadows. I have to get rid of it, make it disappear. The world outside is vast, cold, and uncaring. But inside, here, I'm suffocating.
